title: A Survey of LLM Prompt Datasets: Taxonomy, Linguistic Patterns, and Practical Uses
abstract: arXiv:2510.09316v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We compile 129 public LLM prompt datasets with more than 1.22TB and more than 673M instances and organize them into a unified taxonomy. We use seven datasets for detailed analysis and identify lexical, syntactic, and semantic patterns that distinguish prompts from general text. We evaluate these features in prompt filtering, source domain routing, and elicited response quality analysis. A 63 dimensional linguistic feature set that can be extracted on a CPU achieves over 91% of the F1 of GPU sentence embeddings and reduces latency per request by nearly half. In cross dataset routing, sentence embeddings reach 0.74 Macro-F1 and a structural feature subset reaches 0.61, compared with the chance level of 0.20. Structural routing features remain negatively associated with elicited response quality after prompt length is controlled on UltraFeedback. translated_title: 大语言模型提示数据集综述：分类体系、语言模式与实际应用
translated_abstract: 我们汇编了129个公开的大语言模型提示数据集，总数据量超过1.22TB，包含超过6.73亿个实例，并将其组织成一个统一的分类体系。我们使用七个数据集进行详细分析，识别出区分提示与一般文本的词汇、句法和语义模式。我们在提示过滤、源领域路由和引发响应质量分析中评估了这些特征。一套可在CPU上提取的63维语言特征集，其F1分数达到了GPU句子嵌入的91%以上，并将每次请求的延迟降低了近一半。在跨数据集路由中，句子嵌入达到了0.74的宏F1分数，结构特征子集达到了0.61，而随机水平仅为0.20。在控制提示长度后，结构路由特征在UltraFeedback上仍与引发响应质量呈负相关。在相同条件下，类型-词符比率的明显正相关变得小得多。
tldr: 该论文构建了包含129个提示数据集的统一分类体系，并提出了可在CPU上高效提取的63维语言特征，在提示过滤和路由任务中实现了接近GPU嵌入性能的效果，同时揭示了结构特征与响应质量的负相关关系。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a unified taxonomy of 129 LLM prompt datasets and proposes a 63-dimensional linguistic feature set extractable on CPU, achieving near-GPU embedding performance in prompt filtering and routing while revealing negative correlations between structural features and response quality.
